correctness.rationale: Fourier decomposition L(C_m)⊗I2 + I_m⊗t[[1,-1],[-1,1]] gives strictly ordered cycle eigenvalues ν_j and multiplicities d_j=1/2 in each parity band. At eigenvalue collision ν_j+2t=ν_k the rank required is d_j+d_k; PBH gives universal lower bound. S2 sees every scalar/double except cross-band scalar-scalar case, where (0,0),(1,0) distinguish ± alternating vectors. S3 separates a singleton from interior pair via determinant magnitude 2|sin(2πj/m)|; S4 block-diagonalizes opposite parity interior pairs. Independent eigenspace rank calculations at 23 generic and resonant points for m=5..8 corroborated all minima and harmless even m,t=2.
